title: Mixed Event — Awakening Beat — Episode8 Next to Everyone

meta.Event Outline: Kohane has steadily built up experience, including performing solo at events. An, Akito and Toya all acknowledge her efforts, but Kohane herself doesn't seem confident. An and the others try to get Kohane to believe in herself.

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
Where did she learn to sing like this?!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: She's nothing like she was last time!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (This is nothing like her usual self. Did she just figure out how to commit to herself...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I don't believe it. She changed that much in this little time...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Uh oh... My legs feel pretty shaky...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Kohane's so amazing...
I want to tell her that she did awesome...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But why? Why is it that I can't get myself to just tell her that...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (So this is what she's truly capable of...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Honestly, I still can't believe it, and I'm standing right next to her. Azusawa's never done anything quite like this before...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Were we wrong about her this whole time...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Is she better than we could've ever realized...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Uh, well... We're just really relieved that it's all over now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We finished so quickly, but you guys were just standing there so silently... I was worried that I did something again...

rows.Speaker: MC's Voice
rows.Line: Vivid BAD SQUAD with a miraculous performance! How are our defending champs, EVER, gonna respond to this...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, EVER's going to be on soon too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Akito, let's find a place to watch.

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Way to go, EVER.
Another solid performance.

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: But Vivid BAD SQUAD was just something else. I still can't believe what I saw...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
That girl's voice was unbelievable!

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line: Her spell still hasn't worn off...

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line: The crowd's all thinking about someone who isn't even on stage anymore.

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: I knew that they'd improved, but I didn't expect this. EVER has that sort of power too but...

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line:
That girl was just incredible...
She turned this place upside down.

rows.Speaker: Live House Manager
rows.Line: They're the ones that want to surpass RAD WEEKEND, right? I'm starting to think they might just do it, you know?

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line: But it'll take them a lot more time to master what they've learned...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Here's to winning STAY GOLDEN! Cheers!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Today was so amazing!
The crowd went absolutely wild too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And this is the special curry dad made to celebrate! It's really good, so feel free to get seconds♪

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Anytime. You're celebrating, right? Have as much as you like.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks, dad!
Mmm! It's so delicious...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-An, you might choke if you eat that fast...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But you really shined today, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, why didn't you tell us you had that in you?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The truth is, I don't really remember what happened... But I'm glad everything went so well.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane, that reminds me! This curry's pure yum, but so are these mashed potatoes! Here, have some!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh!
Wow, An, these are so yummy!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Right?!
I can't get enough of them!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, dad, can you get me some more curry?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Sorry, An, you're gonna have to get it yourself. My hands are full cleaning.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'd like some more too, so why don't we go together?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? Alright, back to the counter!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay. That should be enough rice.
Now to cover it in plenty of curry...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was able to stand proud and sing today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And it's all because you said that you believe in me, An.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So I can't thank you enough!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Kohane figured out how to sing way better than she usually does, and I was so happy to see it happen...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It was the most exciting moment we've had so far singing together...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Why do I have this knot in my chest?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane...
You were able to sing like that because you were able to find the answer yourself.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I don't know what this feeling is...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm happy, more than happy that Kohane's finally smiling again. There's absolutely no denying how I feel about what happened, so...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'll keep doing my best!
Let's find a way to surpass RAD WEEKEND together!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And in order to do that, you'll need to dig in and start building up your strength!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What? B-But I can't eat all this...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hahaha. I'm joking! But here's yours.
Wanna head back now?
